name: Tsegyalgar West

location.city: Rancho Los Naranjos, mountains above San Jose del Cabo

tradition: Tibetan Dzogchen (Nyingma), founded by Chogyal Namkhai Norbu
technique: Dzogchen meditation, Yantra Yoga, Vajra Dance; personal or teacher-led retreat
teacherAccess: Self-directed for personal retreats; direct daily access to visiting authorized teachers during teacher-led retreats
retreatOptions: Personal retreats of any length (days to months); scheduled teacher-led retreats several times a year
about: A 3,000-acre wilderness reserve with a temple (Gonpa) housing a Vajra Dance mandala, four casitas, camping, and a shared kitchen. One of the International Dzogchen Community's two main centers worldwide (with Tsegyalgar East in Massachusetts), functioning as both dedicated retreat land and a rental venue for outside groups.
schedule: Teacher-led retreats 5-6 times a year; personal retreats year-round, especially winter
cost: Casita lodging $40-50 USD/night (double occupancy) or camping $10/night; catered meals ~$25/day

pricePerDay.notes: Casita lodging plus catered meals, all-in estimate.

foodNotes: Catered meals available or self-catering with a weekly shopping service.
workNotes: Work-exchange discounts optionally available for long personal retreats.
